title: RulebookReport
description: Authenticated envelope for a Sub-generated encrypted rulebook activity report left in a pair's rulebook mailbox, encrypted to the Owner's current channel "report" receive key. sequence must be greater than every sequence the relay has accepted on this channel for the pair epoch.

expiresAt.description: MUST NOT exceed createdAt + rulebookMailboxExpirySeconds (see constants.json).

senderEphemeralPublicKey.description: Sub's per-upload ephemeral ECDH public key, combined with the receive key named by receiveKeyId. Salt is SHA-256(receivePublicKeyRawUncompressed || senderEphemeralPublicKeyRawUncompressed); HKDF info is "oathbound-relay-rulebook-report-v1" || pairIdHash || receiveKeyId; AAD is JCS of this envelope with ciphertextDigest/nonce/signature removed and ciphertextSizeBytes set to 0; plaintext is gzip-compressed before encryption.
